resource_policy.timeout_placement: sudo executes timeout, which executes the privileged Python process

commands.export: sudo -n timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 90s nice -n 19 env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /opt/leo-tracker/current-api/.venv/bin/python tools/ds7_export_baseline.py --plan reports/2026_09_27_ds7_evaluation_setup/plans/budgets/plan.json --session SESSION --output reports/2026_09_27_ds7_wave2/inputs/SESSION-tracks.json
commands.bank: sudo -n timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 150s nice -n 19 env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /opt/leo-tracker/current-api/.venv/bin/python tools/ds7_export_baseline.py --banks --plan reports/2026_09_27_ds7_evaluation_setup/plans/budgets/plan.json --session SESSION --tracks reports/2026_09_27_ds7_wave2/inputs/SESSION-tracks.json --output .leo/ds7-wave2/baseline/SESSION
commands.freeze: sudo -n nice -n 19 env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /opt/leo-tracker/current-api/.venv/bin/python tools/ds7_eval.py freeze-inputs --plan reports/2026_09_27_ds7_evaluation_setup/plans/budgets/plan.json --index reports/2026_09_27_ds7_wave2/inputs/inputs-prefix4-index.json --output reports/2026_09_27_ds7_wave2/inputs/inputs-prefix4-ready-v1.json

eligibility_receipt.excluded_track_reason: frozen mask has 7 training points and 0 held-out points; bank policy requires at least 2 training and 1 held-out point
eligibility_receipt.required_loader_behavior: validate candidate coverage against eligible observations and retain an explicit exclusion receipt
